trello.name: Fix Android photo upload crash on Android 14
trello.desc: Owner: Marcus. Fix the NullPointerException in the media picker callback that occurs when a user backgrounds the app mid-upload. This is the top crasher, affecting about 4% of Android sessions. Repro: start a photo upload, background the app before it finishes, come back. Fix and verify by Wednesday (before August 20 release) so QA has time before release. Sam to confirm the fix on Android 14 test devices and add it to the regression run once Marcus lands the fix.

trello.name: Build sync API endpoint for offline notes mode
trello.desc: Owner: Elena. Build the backend sync API for the notes list offline mode: the client sends its last-synced timestamp and receives a delta of created, updated, and deleted notes. Conflict resolution is last-write-wins for now; no merge UI in this pass. Elena to have the sync API in review before she is out on the 17th and 18th.

trello.name: Implement client-side offline mode for notes list
trello.desc: Owner: Marcus. Implement the client side of offline mode for the notes list: local cache in Room, queue writes while offline, and replay them when connectivity returns. Acceptance criteria: user can open the app in airplane mode, see their notes, edit them, and everything reconciles when back online with no data loss. Marcus to write these acceptance criteria into the ticket.

trello.name: Migrate CI pipelines from Jenkins to GitHub Actions
trello.desc: Owner: Sam. Sam already has a proof of concept for the build job. This sprint: finish the test and release pipelines, keep the nightly build schedule, and run both Jenkins and GitHub Actions in parallel for a week before turning Jenkins off. Keep Jenkins alive until the parallel week is clean. Approved by Priya.

trello.name: Add per-user rate limiting to search endpoint
trello.desc: Owner: Elena. Add per-user rate limiting to the search endpoint, which was degraded by a misbehaving script last week. Limit: 100 requests per minute per user. Return HTTP 429 with a Retry-After header beyond that. Also add a metrics counter so the team can see which users are hitting the limit.

trello.name: Update GDPR consent screen for EU launch
trello.desc: Owner: Marcus. Legal flagged that the current consent screen does not meet GDPR requirements for the EU launch. Update the privacy policy screen so consent is opt-in with separate toggles for analytics and marketing, not a single pre-checked box. Marcus to get the new copy from legal and rebuild the screen. Nothing should be pre-checked. This is a launch blocker and must be in the August 20 release.

trello.name: Write regression tests for payments flow
trello.desc: Owner: Sam. Write automated regression tests for the payments flow, which currently has no automated coverage and caused issues in the last release. Cover: purchase, restore, cancellation, and the receipt validation path. Goal is to have these tests running in CI as part of the new GitHub Actions pipeline.
